claim: Finetuned GPT-4, GPT-4o, and Llama-3 models predict their own hypothetical behavior better than a different model trained on their ground-truth behavior, offered as evidence of introspection.
scope_conditions: Behavioral self-prediction, not code correctness or calibration
quoted_support: we find that the model M1 outperforms M2 in predicting itself, providing evidence for introspection.
